author: shiftrox
body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shiftrox/23tmL4tmYtSwNycLRMNNAmjM5B7S6wVGgYuPzDgDKgrT5wjNvG3G3XPQvcZnKj1uWA4vC.jpg)[Unsplash](https://unsplash.com/pt-br/fotografias/unidade-na-sinalizacao-bancaria-LeqCI5v81-c)
![lotus_divisor.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shiftrox/Eo1vWsZeeczZ1i57cBaQiPD1qrfxLPrjFZomzrstqa7YcNvz2SUJB1CHGticzFo5rRK.png) Today, I had to go to one of the branches of the “Caixa Econômica Federal” bank to resolve some pending issues regarding the sale of my apartment, in order to speed up the process, as I really need to move it forward. At the moment, I am having to manage to pay for everything related to to my previous apartment and the one I'm in now, so I really need to get this previous one out of my name and get rid of the bills that are on it. The thing is, when I went to that agency, it was a bit complicated. Not that all employees are bad or don't care about us, their customers, but I was unfortunately served by a manager who I didn't like very much. She didn't treat me badly or anything like that, she didn't curse at me or lose her temper, she just I thought it was bad that everything my broker was asking me to do, the manager simply said that it was impossible and that she had never seen that before, that no one requested what my broker was asking for. I thought it was complicated, because I was caught in the crossfire, but What I found really annoying was that I had to issue a bill in my name, called a “quit bill” and that it would have to include the code or CNPJ of another bank (Itaú), because it would be through this bank that the buyers of my apartment old would finance it. Well, at the beginning she said that this was not possible, that there was no way to do it, because no one asked to do this, so, while exchanging some audios with my broker, she simply said that “she found a field where she could put the CNPJ of another bank” and I smiled awkwardly at her. Ok, the field miraculously appeared. After that, I was able to issue the boleto the way my broker requested and then came the other challenge: my broker sent about 3 emails and asked the manager to send the bill and some other things to them and again she said that there was no way and that no one asked for emails to be sent. I took a deep breath and just thanked her for everything and left there. I sent some more audios to my broker and she said that it was okay, that she would resolve it later if there was any problem in the future due to the email not being sent. Anyway, after I got home and spent some time, my broker said that the email had simply arrived for her and for another professional involved in the process. So, I keep asking myself: was this a lack of willingness to help? Or is the process just bureaucratic and bad? Well, I just avoid judging and, instead, I am grateful that everything worked out. This is a little bit of how it works. Brazil. ![sun_divisor.webp](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXEDLx7R7Jy8fHF1tA7sPyb4A9QBvmj3y4FjFhephcPCS/sun_divisor.webp)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shiftrox/23tmL4tmYtSwNycLRMNNAmjM5B7S6wVGgYuPzDgDKgrT5wjNvG3G3XPQvcZnKj1uWA4vC.jpg)[Unsplash](https://unsplash.com/pt-br/fotografias/unidade-na-sinalizacao-bancaria-LeqCI5v81-c)
![lotus_divisor.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shiftrox/Eo1vWsZeeczZ1i57cBaQiPD1qrfxLPrjFZomzrstqa7YcNvz2SUJB1CHGticzFo5rRK.png) Hoje, precisei ir em uma das agências do banco da “Caixa Econômica Federal” para resolver algumas pendências em relação à venda do meu apartamento, para poder agilizar o processo, pois realmente preciso passá-lo para frente. No momento, estou tendo que me virar para pagar tudo relacionado ao meu apartamento anterior e ao que estou agora, então preciso realmente tirar este anterior do meu nome e ficar livre das contas que têm em cima dele. Acontece que, ao ir nessa agência, foi um pouco complicado. Não que todos os funcionários sejam ruins ou estejam pouco se ligando para nós, seus clientes, mas fui infelizmente atendido por uma gerente que não me agradou muito. Ela não me tratou mal ou coisa do tipo, não me xingou ou perdeu a paciência, apenas achei ruim que tudo o que a minha corretora estava pedindo para fazer, a gerente simplesmente dizia que não tinha como e que nunca vira aquilo antes, que ninguém solicitava o que minha corretora estava solicitando. Achei complicado, porque fiquei no fogo cruzado, mas o que achei bem chato mesmo foi que precisava emitir um boleto em meu nome, chamado de “boleto de quitação” e que nele deveria constar o código ou o CNPJ de outro banco (Itaú), porque seria por este banco que os compradores do meu apartamento antigo iriam financiá-lo. Bem, no começo ela já disse que isso não era possível, que não teria como fazer, porque ninguém pedia para fazer isso, então, enquanto trocava alguns áudios com a minha corretora, ela simplesmente disse que “achou um campo em que podia colocar o CNPJ de outro banco” e fiquei com um sorriso sem graça para ela. Ok, o campo milagrosamente apareceu. Depois disso, consegui emitir o boleto da forma que minha corretora solicitou e então veio o outro desafio: minha corretora passou uns 3 e-mails e pediu para a gerente enviar o boleto e algumas outras coisas para eles e novamente ela disse que não teria como e que ninguém pedia para que e-mails fossem enviados. Respirei fundo e apenas agradeci por tudo e saí dali. Mandei mais alguns áudios para a minha corretora e ela disse que tudo bem, que depois iria resolver caso desse algum problema no futuro por conta deste não envio do correio eletrônico. Enfim, após chegar em casa e passar um tempo, minha corretora disse que simplesmente o e-mail chegou para ela e para outra profissional envolvida no processo. Assim, fico com a pergunta na cabeça: isso foi falta de vontade de ajudar? Ou o processo é burocrático e ruim mesmo? Bem, evito apenas julgar e, no lugar, agradeço que tudo deu certo. Isso é um pouco de como funciona o Brasil. ![lotus_divisor.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shiftrox/Eo1vWsZeeczZ1i57cBaQiPD1qrfxLPrjFZomzrstqa7YcNvz2SUJB1CHGticzFo5rRK.png)

author: f0rtunate
body:
**Update on My Mom’s Situation**  

Yesterday, we were able to visit my mom. She was still sedated (on the ventilator), but her norepinephrine levels were at 0.04, which is great news.  

However, today they will perform a tracheostomy on her to provide more comfort and eventually remove her from the ventilator.  

My mom is Catholic, so, following her tradition, I called a priest from the Paulinian congregation (a monastery of priests) to administer the Anointing of the Sick to her. He came, blessed her, and prayed with her, even though she was on the ventilator. Here in Brazil, religious visits are allowed at any time in hospital rooms.  

Tomorrow, we will receive the results of a test that will determine whether she has a terminal disease called Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease. We are praying and asking God that the test comes back negative and that it is instead the manifestation of another illness (this is a possibility).  

We also requested a visit from a rheumatologist, but the head doctor has not authorized it. I don’t know if it’s out of ego or stubbornness, but we are continuing to fight for it.  

Thank you for your prayers and support! Every kind word has meant so much to us.  

I also pray to God for those who have lost loved ones and are still grieving. May they find comfort and feel embraced.  

Thank you,  
Amanda

-------
(1)
Perhaps this is my most emotional text. It's been a while since I last wrote anything, but this time I need to.  

My mother is in the neurological ICU of a hospital in São Paulo called Beneficência Portuguesa. She is currently in an induced coma to stabilize her condition. We are desperate because it costs us around 120 Reais every two days to get there. My sister and I take turns as her companion every 12 hours. We tell her stories about how important she is to us, how much she makes us laugh, how incredible she is, and how her life has made a difference in the lives of others.  

She loves to sing, but today, intubated, she will hardly sing again anytime soon. She is also an English teacher at a school in a marginalized community, and she is highly respected for her love and care for the children, regardless of their origins or who their parents are.  

My mother is not only incredible for what she does there, but also for what she has done for us—her sleepless nights, her long hours of work to buy us a gift, her efforts to teach us English, her dreams...  

We have a pending exam to pay for. If you can, please help us here. If you can’t, just pray for her or send positive energy. We need a miracle. Emotional or financial support makes a difference. A strong hug,  
A.

author: steemflow
body:
In Hindi, there is a famous phrases which says :

> **"jako rakhe sayian maar sake na koi"** 

The phrase simply states that, the one who is guarded by or protected by God, cannot be killed by anyone. Today, was one such day, when I helped someone to be out of danger. It gives me immense sense of joy and happiness. It was none other than saving a small life in pigeon. 


![1000124487.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/AJpkXVMQJLUjQDjbXGUS46GicQLJh1BX7bkr6Bh53pSnHt3VqaRxRFGbGmUKh12.jpg)


Doing good deeds often generates feelings of warmth, joy, satisfaction, and a sense of fulfillment. At the same time, Saving a life can feel like an overwhelming mix of immense relief, profound satisfaction, a sense of accomplishment, and a deep gratitude for the opportunity to make such a significant impact. I was feeling elated, having successfully intervened in a critical situation. 

It was a usual quite afternoon, and I was busy watching a movie, when I heard the sound of flapping wings. It was very common due to presence of pigeons around. However, today was different. It was continous flapping like sending some kind of SOS signal. I went out and moved towards the sound direction, only to find a helpless pigeons struck in an old crumbled door. 



|![1000123830.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/23yTdC654BzQpdhBWiYnN4PHhTMukxj9tRQeSgfdFbUrYyc96cwAjGyyhqbpFzdzvCdYc.jpg)|![1000123836.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/23xKtDGWrVD1bUavscPPZE5CcZ1R4KUKX7gvfEDCBubwm95D1rz3TtNP3ke9MKiTASEjJ.jpg)|
|-|-|

|![1000123824.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/23wWuGsee4GR1pPdxKiHLzHz4Hzh6EtXdowLTiyq19MXm8DzLVCMujU8jPhhDUzDuqaM7.jpg)|![1000123827.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/23xAXYcfHAH3GfAcvwy9JQ6ucC9BqfgtRvHFgqzLQZh2JsnLDXueCa6wFRN6B9cmwF4Pm.jpg)|
|-|-|

The pigeon was hanging upside down. On first look it appeared that the pigeon tangled itself into rope, which got stuck in the broken door. It was an old door, and the pigeon often get inside through it to lay eggs. The room was empty and not occupied. I quickly turned on my saviour mode, and prepaired myself to save it. I don't wanted to hurt the little life more, soyook the help of a cloth to get hold of it. 


|![1000123863.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/23xVJwjkTDDvNGU5Qh82a3t7U6bLhqMhG1ukkK4D2hkyjMm7ctEJZL9CUxecURDqgfdMy.jpg)|![1000123854.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/23xVMbVBgQjVNVYYX9CbbsvqHqNdgDo4eXxrutkefTZBj8r8cwJA1puJejY2NGQAQYqeR.jpg)|
|-|-|

|![1000123848.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/23xVKAK35nGsij83Kuk7Lb2pqSmx8dt7brcL5bB77JHmqqBy2B1gac21FtQUKkFnTbaa6.jpg)|![1000123851.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/23xehpY1UpoeJqGX61faiwmFm3GH3y86UqfGHzJJ7CKV8kY25Aa9Qje1YV9BdcDQkqoxz.jpg)|
|-|-|

On removing the pigeon from the door, it was learnt that the pigeon fry away from some trap. The rope was not tangled of its own. It was kind of trap, from the hunter, and the pigeon avle to fly away with it. It was tightly noose around both the legs. 


|![1000123866.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/23yJGPistRbyfvqcV2D1xJTKcdvzjgtTdArzH5wcVPSenW7JnjfEtmHXY6yZ8zSz9FAXH.jpg)|![1000123803.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/23ywq7XH5F8o5pDuNRAadAEHrtiY7KXC33srb2tJkmJwrrBZvi9XK4AQDvqfp8MpjQRT6.jpg)|
|-|-|

|![1000123869.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/23xyV4z3ykm7RVhThfzL4UP5DBNgTKfuYodxonf1FAEi93hqrr6NEV4CmiXqqnLP4qGLY.jpg)|![1000123806.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/23yJGY2B6265xdXA4XHZNQjaHQQn4XEfEjDvvwK5r2pSkdrn2SbgjiBWiehQrdBLg2BmD.jpg)|
|-|-|
 
I try to let the pigeon free by untying the knots. However with one hand, it was not easy. I even tried to cut the rope with scissors, but the pigeons appears to be in pain. I call my brother for help.


![1000123884.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/242Y9hrv7ouL6zXeZnAkcWqMQ61B9JKLPFerVnbdG975YUMS2zZuvEanjR6PYQxk63diU.jpg)

![1000123887.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/23xyXVqxM11ycgWhPGK1nk7jaNXqVpLhMPzKLu2DGVh9G3nTgx97crQ9o2iJp9JziyvSR.jpg)
 
Even though I hold the pigeon firmly in my hand, it appears he was in too much discomfort. May be he applied too much effort before I pitched in for his help. He was releasing water from.hi mouth, like vomiting. But we were desperate to set it free. After much effort and cutting most of the threads from it's leg. I let it free.


![1000124449.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/23y8x2dcy3FMcPyPTVNgfAeQJETsNxAarfFnbu11B9RqDrbbqEChuuzCBTwVHsEoaHb5b.jpg)
 

As soon as I kept it down, he quickly fly away on the terrace. It was a great feeling of satisfaction finding he was completelly OK. May be I was means to save him from his discomfort. The noose on his legs was not new and he must be carrying it since long. But now everything seems fine. I am thankful to God for allowing me to do some good deeds.


## In good faith - Peace!


![1000037470.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/Eo8M1obna2cYnnMAc2ZC3wWMW9ZqZHvk9StEga6aY2cTsKmweW7zFBDm7D13YHVoC5N.png)

author: gtpacheko17
body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT9uFk7VNfdd9BgsH59RGsc5T141VrmrSzF4CMrGG79NX/1736617669199.jpg)

My friends probably remember how crazy I was for the PS5 last year and how much I wanted to get one. After getting one and using it for a few months, I eventually traded it for a PC.

But the thing is, I had traded a PC for the PS5.
It's all trade-trade-trade. Why? Well, because I don't have a lot of money so this is how I get to experience new things.
And the next experience that I have in mind is the Steam Deck.

I've been following the Deck around since it was originally announced and I knew from the start I wanted to get one.
Back in the day I sold the PC I had for $600 (adjusted for inflation) so I could save up and get one. Buuut I ended up buying another PC instead when the crypto boom died down, and it was a great PC.

Shit happened and we get to where we are now.
However, there's a reason to why I think the Deck might be a little different.

And that reason is this:


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT3v1hsv1QHz4K4qbQkEaDLXyyDHN2Fr9XN9C1DB7bWMq/1736617956575.jpg)

The Steam Deck is a fully fleshed out Linux PC that can be used docked like any other Linux PC.

From what I've seen, everything that my PC does, the Deck does too, specially considering the fact that I run Linux on my main PC.

If I can play games, edit videos with Kdenlive, edit photos with GIMP and publish stuff on HIVE, that's all I need!

So that's the reason why I'm sort of positive I won't be trading my future Deck anytime soon, because it's a PC.

And what about my current PC?
Well, it might be a bit hard to trade it for a Deck, but if I get lucky it might just happen.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaStmq6WA3hidpAb8zKomADTu1aqhRDyXwCvqX3Pxq4Xy/1736618135996.jpg)

This is my current PC. An i5 7600, GTX 1660 Super and 16GBs of RAM. Worth around the R$2500 mark down here in the middle of nowhere. That's also the price I can find the cheapest Decks for in big cities... Unfortunately I don't live in a big city, so that's why I'm mentioning luck.

In the end it'll be a game of waiting. I'll keep writing to HIVE and trying to find odd jobs, as my knee doesn't allow me to keep a fixed job but if anyone shows up wanting to trade a Deck in good condition for my PC, the answer will most likely be a resounding yes.

Let's wait and see y'all, wait and see.

If you wanna help me get there, just upvote my posts! I won't ask for donations, I'll ask for curation. I love doing what I'm doing and if I manage to get the Deck through HIVE, it'll be the most rewarding moment of my life.

author: janwrites
body:
![jr-korpa-N8OcpX-zK6s-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/janwrites/23zaj83wAYEL1r1EEbZrFqZ2mPpFYcFpMWze9fGszzwDHLxdpD8GiLktCuEMTCPu9efZ6.jpg)


I’ve never shared this online before. 

A few close friends know about it, but we didn’t really dive into it. Maybe writing it down will help me untangle the mystery...or maybe not. At least I tried.

This happened 27 years ago when I was in first grade at Lipata Central School. It’s one of the reasons I believe in the paranormal even if it doesn't make any sense.

## It was lunch break

...and my yaya (nanny) had just bought me a slice of chiffon cake. I’ve always been a sentimental kid, so instead of eating it right away, I decided to save it. I tied the cellophane-wrapped cake to my bag, thinking it would remind me of her for the rest of the day. I waved goodbye as she left, then went off to play with my classmates.

Our school was spacious back then, with classrooms scattered across open grounds instead of being in a single building. My classroom was part of a newer JICA block donated by Japan. Across from it were older classrooms, where we decided to hang out that day.

One of my friends found a strange spot behind one of those old classrooms. The ground there was “bouncy.” It looked like regular dirt, but when we jumped on it, it felt like a trampoline. Naturally, we were intrigued. I even sat down to inspect it, wondering if something like a buried basketball was making it springy.

Eventually, we got bored with it and parted ways. I started heading back to my classroom, but then everything shifted.

## Suddenly, it was like I was in a dream... 

People started running in my direction, their faces filled with panic. It was as if some disaster had struck behind me, and I was the only one standing still.

I froze, trying to make sense of it. 

The chaos was overwhelming... students gasping, some boys yelling, feet pounding the ground. I thought I heard someone shout something about a lion and a dog “boxing.” Yes, *boxing*. It made no sense, but I still can remember clearly the exact words.

## What made it even more surreal 

...was how everyone I looked at would go from acting normal... walking, chatting... to suddenly sprinting in my direction in panic the moment my eyes laid on them.

It was like my gaze triggered their fear. It felt like a lucid dream where things change when I focus on them. I started crying, overwhelmed and terrified, as older kids pushed past me. My tiny frame was no match for the stampede.

Except for that day, I've never experienced a stampede in my entire life. To this day, I can still feel the weight of those shoulders pushing against mine.

I stumbled forward, running against the crowd, desperate for help. That’s when I saw her, a girl heading in the same direction as me, the only one not running away. 

## In my panic, I grabbed her skirt and clung to it like my life depended on it. 

I even got dragged a few steps, scraping my arms on the ground.

She stopped, startled, sat down trying to help me up. "What happened?" she asked, alarmed.

Through tears, I remember blurting out, *"Ana sila naay lion ug iro na nag-boxing!"* (They said a lion and a dog were boxing!)

She looked at me, clearly confused, but she crouched down and tried to calm me. "No, there’s no lion and dog boxing," she said trying to convince me, putting my arm over her shoulder to help me stand. 

"Where are they running to?"
"Nobody's running"

And then—everything went black.

When I came to, my eyes still closed, I heard voices. "She passed out," the girl whispered. It was the first time I heard the word. *Kuyapan* (fainting) was not yet a familiar word to me..

## When I opened my eyes, I was in a dark classroom with no lights on. 

It was one of those old classrooms right across mine. The door was open and I could make sense of the time from the afternoon hues. There were three students sitting on the front row seats, waiting for me to wake up. 

Three kids sat in the front row, near the door: two girls and a boy. They watched me intently, waiting for me to wake up. Their uniforms were neat and they looked at me in silence, as if waiting for me to tell them what the heck happened.

I sat up, disoriented. My first thought was that I was late for class. Mrs. Medida, my teacher, had a reputation for being strict, and I dreaded the scolding I was sure to get. Without saying a word to the three kids (who had waited for me the entire afternoon!) I jumped off the teacher's table (it was quite high) and I bolted out of the classroom.

I didn't even get the chance to thank them. They waited for me the entire afternoon on that dark Grade 3 classroom, probably excited to hear my story, looking after me until I woke up. 

As I ran across the open space to my room, I glanced at the sky. I remember the orange-pink hues that reminded me how late I was. 

![seny-g-AQxmPtgXWJs-unsplash (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/janwrites/23tmcpiwV5mp9zgJdu7c9z8Krg6QkZCHYoZWBWSA7wApwBj1M4y6i5bya6SoHAQK3uAKX.jpg)


When I walked in, bracing for some scolding, my teacher continued with her lesson as if she hadn't seen me. It was unusual, but I sighed in relief as I got to my seat. She continued her lesson like nobody just came in without explanation.

I sank into my seat, heart pounding. I looked at my bag, and remembered feeling a bit sad when my chiffon cake was no longer there. Glancing at the clock, I realized it was almost 5 p.m. I’d been unconscious for nearly four hours. I waited until the rest of the class for anyone to mention something significant happened that day, the day went on as usual.

## A strange silence in me.

There was a strange silence in me that afternoon that I couldn't even share what happened to anyone because it was too huge for my tiny mind to grasp. I felt that I didn't even know where to start or what to make of it.

Over the years, I've grown more attuned to signs. In certain places, I instinctively feel the need to be cautious, even without a clear reason. It's almost as if I can sense when a large tree or a particular spot in nature is home to something unseen.

I haven’t developed any paranormal abilities or “gifts,” but this experience has led me to believe there’s more to the world than what meets the eye.

## For years, I didn’t think much about the details. 

It was just a bizarre memory I rarely revisited.
I went back to the school 10 years ago hoping to find answers, but a lot has changed. The old classrooms were no longer there and it also was too late in the afternoon that I didn't take the risk to search around for that bouncy spot.

I know it's been 27 years but this was a very vivid memory. Trust me that I was so sure that this wasn't a false memory of a dream, I was there and the surreal happened. 

I didn't try to recall it that much over the years to spot for loose ends, it's just how far my memory went. However, it was only until recently that I realized that something was off with my story.

Who are those 3 kids, why were they not in their classes? 

How were they able to lift me up to the teacher's table and waited for me as I slept, sitting in a dark classroom with no lights and fans on? How were they able to guard me for roughly 4 hours without telling my teacher about it (my classroom was just right across that old room and I had an ID)?

The more I think about it, the stranger it feels. They looked perfectly normal... just kids in uniforms. But the longer I dwell on it, the more I’m convinced there was something... not quite human about them.

Even now, as I write this, it sends chills down my spine. 
What happened to me?

*This guide will help you get started with Hive and Cur8, providing the tools and knowledge you need to create, share, and earn as a content creator*


![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbr8FNJsULyBFd2wLBXRkPGAMSeZKc78oxSHgDyk3FEXF/image.png)


## What is Hive and How Can It Help You Earn?

**Hive** is a blockchain-based social network that rewards users for creating and sharing original and valuable content. By publishing articles, stories, photos, and other interesting content, you can earn cryptocurrency rewards based on the votes received from the community.
These rewards come in the form of HIVE, a type of cryptocurrency, the more votes and support your post gets from the community, the more you earn.

*If you want to learn more about the technical side of Hive, I recommend you to read the official whitepaper: https://hive.io/whitepaper.pdf*

---

## Peakd and Cur8

[Peakd](https://www.peakd.com) is one of the main platform for the Hive blockchain, where you can read posts, leave comments, manage you funds and fully enjoy the social experience.

[Cur8](https://www.cur8hive.surge.sh), on the other hand, focuses on optimizing curation returns for our delegators and developing content creation tools for authors in order to simplify and improve the posting process.


![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTLV3ADvSoK8whfkto6CAjzBxmBHhTYRCDNH8h86EkMqd/image.png)

---

## What is Cur8?

**Cur8** is a curator dedicated to the Hive blockchain. Thanks to our delegators, we are building a community of passionate writers and readers. Our mission is to enhance the Hive ecosystem by bringing in new users, educating them, and supporting both newcomers and experienced users.

To achieve this, we provide valuable tools like our new [Telegram mini app](https://t.me/cur8_hiveBot), designed to simplify and improve the posting experience on Hive.

<center>
![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWUcZAApcjtCaLWxB4NjggrGJMnCE9ee7RpqYVd2Nsdcb/image.jpeg)
</center>

---

## Creating Your Hive Account

With our [Telegram bot](https://t.me/cur8_hiveBot), you can easily create a free Hive account. Important: Once your account is created, **REMEMBER TO SAVE YOUR PRIVATE KEYS** – without them, you won’t be able to access your account in the future!

<center>![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmV26htVi5EpZ39NF5oNrjUyvavjZRqP5RQneiCZ81PoCM/image.gif)</center>

*If you already have an Hive account, you can skip this process and log in directly to the [web app](https://t.me/cur8_hiveBot).*

---

## What are Keys for?

Private keys are essential for accessing and managing your account securely. Each key serves a specific purpose, offering varying levels of access and functionalities:

**Master Key**: Full account control and recovery. Keep offline and secure.

**Owner Key**: Used to reset keys and regain account control.

**Active Key**: For transferring funds and managing account settings.

**Posting Key**: For posts, voting, and commenting.

**Memo Key**: For encrypting private messages during transfers.

---

## Login to Cur8 Posting Mini App

To access our Telegram app open [Cur8 bot](https://t.me/cur8_hiveBot), start the bot, and simply click the **APP** button in the bottom left corner, then you can choose between two login methods:

- Login via Hivesigner with the **Active key**: This method is more reliable and requires the Active key to grant Cur8 posting authorization.

- Login with the **Posting key**: This is the direct method provided by the app. The key will be encrypted and never shared.

<center>![Immagine](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWyqTH3Ewqy2juZrGCN6akdQHBvSfvKKkwpiKy3GGwqeK/image.gif)</center>

---

## Exploring Our Web App

The web app is simple and intuitive, offering:

- **Account Management**: Manage and add your Hive accounts, select one for posting, or log out.

- **Publish**: Create posts with titles, content, tags, images, GIFs, and select a community.

- **Drafts**: Review, edit, and publish saved posts.

- **Settings**: Customize theme and language for each account.


![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmU4WRsgEWkwEaZZpDC7Sp42gARLKn3mCpqUdnZwD3mtNR/image.png)

![Immagine](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXfN146AdXCg4xetWWBbsuTzM2hQFsMnSEEboCJS792EN/image.png)



**Key features also include**:

**Post Scheduling**: Publish at a chosen time.

**Save Drafts**: Work on content at your own pace.

**Preview**: See your post before publishing.

**Markdown Tools**: Easily format and style your text.



`You'll find some useful tutorials in the Telegram bot menu!`


---

## Your first post on Hive

Your first post is very important as it acts as your introduction to the community and sets the tone for your account. A well-crafted first post can help you start on the right foot and attract attention from other users.

Take some time to explore [Peakd](https://www.peakd.com), browse through the [communities](https://peakd.com/communities), and check out posts from other authors to get a feel for the platform.

To create your post with the [Cur8 App](https://t.me/cur8_hiveBot), go to the **Publish** section. Add a title, write your content in the body, and choose relevant tags. The first tag is the most important, you can use "introduceyourself" to maximize visibility for your introduction. Use the preview button to see how your post will look and choose a community where you would publish your content, then click Publish Now and confirm to share it with the world.


<center>![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVSJDcHwuuaS2QnZHdHDebYcKpubJo3Wd7WewV3xxjRiU/image.jpeg)</center>

*(Learn Markdown to make your posts more engaging. [Here's a quick guide](https://peakd.com/markdown/@gmuxx/a-beginner-s-guide-to-markdown))*

## How to schedule a post

Scheduled posts are an excellent tool for planning your content in advance. Whether you're targeting a specific time zone or preparing a campaign, scheduling ensures your posts go live exactly when you want.
Here's how to schedule a post using the [Cur8 App](https://t.me/cur8_hiveBot):

- **Fill Out the Post Details**: Begin by creating your post as you would normally. Add a title, content, tags, and select a community.

- **Choose the Scheduled Time**: Tap on the clock icon, select the date and time for your post to be published. Make sure to double-check the time to ensure accuracy.

- **Confirm and Save**: After selecting the desired time, confirm your choice. Then, save your post.

- **Check the Scheduled Tab**: Your post will now appear in the Scheduled tab under the Drafts menu.

- **Automatic Publishing**: At the scheduled time, the system will automatically publish your post to the Hive blockchain. No further action is required from your side.

<center>![Immagine](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcSBZARNhc622Q2rg92dLTH91PmjXWW2LX4PUCZR2nRAn/image.gif)</center>


## Tips for Earning Successfully on Hive

Getting started with publishing is easy, but to achieve good results, follow these practical tips and community guidelines:

**Avoid plagiarism and low-quality content**: Hive rewards original content. Don’t copy from other sources without crediting and aim to create high-value content.

**Limit the use of AI tools**: AI-generated content is often frowned upon. Focus on authentic, original creations.

**Learn the communities**: Each Hive community has specific rules. Participate in initiatives, follow the guidelines, and join contests to gain recognition from curators.

**Be active and participate**: Engage with others, join contests, and involve yourself in community activities.

**Don’t give up**: The beginning can be tough, but with persistence and dedication, you’ll find your space.

**Comment and interact**: Leave meaningful comments on other posts to gain visibility and build a good reputation.

**Don’t hesitate to ask for help**: Moderators and experienced users can assist you with rules and doubts.

**Create original and quality content**: Hive curators are always on the lookout for interesting posts to reward.

---

*With our web app, you have all the tools to start publishing and earning. Have fun and good luck on Hive!*


<center>![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmU3sehxQkekaasxxRmNwQ5RTRfyy4kuPcMHM6gC6sqA8o/image.png)</center>

<center>[**WEBSITE**](https://www.cur8hive.surge.sh)  |  [**TELEGRAM APP**](https://t.me/cur8_hiveBot)  |  [**TON SWAP**](https://t.me/Cur8TonSwapBot)  |  [**RESOURCES**](https://t.me/cur8_earn)  |  [**SUPPORT**](https://t.me/cur8support)</center>
